summary: 3D Silk Road trade strategy on a low-poly map of Anatolia, built by Claude Opus 5.5 · Anadolu haritasında 3D İpek Yolu ticaret stratejisi, Claude Opus 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Seven cities with their own supply and demand; prices react to your trades and to three rival merchants
Camel caravans follow the roads, stop at caravanserais at night, and need guards against bandits on neglected roads
Goal: 10,000 akçe and 3 caravanserais before the end of year 5; seasons, contracts, plague and festivals change the market
The ?auto bot won 12 of 12 seeded runs between day 158 and day 211; a careless bot went bankrupt in the first season every time
About 60 fps (vsync cap) on Intel UHD 620 at 1280x720 with 20-29 draw calls; one index.html, optional CC0 asset pass

social.headline: Lead camel caravans across Anatolia: buy low, sell high, build caravanserais · Deve kervanlarıyla Anadolu'da ucuza al, pahalıya sat, kervansaray kur

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository; editorial fields hand-written from the README, index.html and docs/assets.md; no field is generated from a guess
